title: Academic Calendar Updates for Fall 2025 Semester
author: Office of the Registrar
excerpt: The Fall 2025 academic calendar has been finalized. Key dates include orientation on August 25, first day of classes on September 2, and final examinations from December 15–20.
body:
Dear Kingster Community,

The Office of the Registrar is pleased to announce the finalized Fall 2025 Academic Calendar. Please review the key dates below and plan accordingly.

Key Dates:
• August 25: New Student Orientation
• September 2: First Day of Classes
• October 13–14: Fall Recess (No Classes)
• November 27–28: Thanksgiving Break
• December 13: Last Day of Classes
• December 15–20: Final Examination Period
• December 22: Grades Due

For the complete academic calendar, please visit the Registrar's website or contact our office directly.

title: Campus-Wide Network Maintenance — July 12, 2025
author: Office of Information Technology
excerpt: Planned network maintenance will take place on Saturday, July 12 from 2:00 AM to 6:00 AM. Internet access, email, and university portals will be temporarily unavailable during this window.
body:
Dear Faculty, Staff, and Students,

The Office of Information Technology (OIT) will be conducting planned campus-wide network maintenance on Saturday, July 12, 2025 from 2:00 AM to 6:00 AM.

Affected Services:
• Campus Wi-Fi (all buildings)
• Email and Microsoft 365 Suite
• Student Portal and Blackboard LMS
• Library Database Access
• VPN Services

We recommend saving all work before the maintenance window. If you experience issues after 6:00 AM, please contact the IT Help Desk at helpdesk@kingster.edu or call ext. 4357.

title: Updated Health & Safety Protocols — On-Campus Events
author: Office of Campus Safety
excerpt: Effective June 1, 2025, updated health and safety protocols are in effect for all on-campus events with attendance exceeding 100 persons. Event organizers must submit a safety plan 14 days in advance.
body:
Dear Campus Community,

Effective June 1, 2025, the following updated health and safety protocols are in effect for all on-campus events with an expected attendance of 100 or more persons.

Required Actions for Event Organizers:
• Submit an Event Safety Plan at least 14 days prior to the event date
• Designate a trained First Aid Coordinator for events >200 attendees
• Ensure emergency exits are clearly marked and accessible
• Provide a maximum crowd density of 2.5 sq ft per person indoors

For questions or to submit your Event Safety Plan, contact the Office of Campus Safety at safety@kingster.edu.

title: Spring 2025 Grade Submission Deadline — May 30
author: Office of the Registrar
excerpt: All faculty are reminded that Spring 2025 final grades must be submitted via the Faculty Portal by 11:59 PM on Friday, May 30, 2025. Late submissions will require Dean's approval.
body:
Dear Faculty,

This is a reminder that Spring 2025 final grades must be submitted via the Faculty Portal by 11:59 PM on Friday, May 30, 2025.

Instructions:
1. Log in to the Faculty Portal at portal.kingster.edu
2. Navigate to Grade Submission > Spring 2025
3. Enter grades for each enrolled student
4. Click Submit — do NOT save as draft

Grade changes after the deadline require written approval from your Department Chair and the Dean's Office. Incomplete (I) grades must be accompanied by a completed Incomplete Grade Contract.

For technical issues, contact the Registrar's Office at registrar@kingster.edu.

title: New Parking Policy — Effective August 1, 2025
author: Facilities Management
excerpt: A revised campus parking policy will take effect August 1, 2025. All vehicles must display a valid 2025–2026 parking permit. Permits are available for purchase through the Facilities Management portal beginning July 1.
body:
Dear Kingster Community,

Facilities Management announces a revised Campus Parking Policy effective August 1, 2025. The updated policy aims to improve traffic flow, increase permit availability for commuter students, and enhance safety in all campus parking areas.

Key Changes:
• All vehicles must display a valid 2025–2026 parking permit (color-coded by zone)
• Permit purchase opens July 1 at facilities.kingster.edu
• Zone A (Faculty/Staff): Lots 1–6 adjacent to academic buildings
• Zone B (Commuter Students): Lots 7–12 and North Campus Garage
• Zone C (Residential Students): Lots 13–18
• Guest parking available in Visitor Lot adjacent to Welcome Center

Vehicles without a valid permit after August 1 will be subject to fines starting at $75.

title: Library Extended Hours — Finals Week December 2025
author: Kingster University Library
excerpt: The Kingster University Library will extend its operating hours during Finals Week (December 15–20, 2025), remaining open 24 hours on December 16–19 to support student exam preparation.
body:
Dear Students,

The Kingster University Library is pleased to announce extended operating hours during Finals Week, December 15–20, 2025.

Extended Library Hours:
• December 15 (Monday): 7:00 AM – 2:00 AM
• December 16–19 (Tue–Fri): Open 24 Hours
• December 20 (Saturday): 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM

Study Rooms: All group study rooms will be available on a first-come, first-served basis during extended hours. Online reservations open December 8.

Refreshments: The Library Café will maintain regular hours. Vending machines are available 24/7 in the ground floor lobby.

We wish all students the best of luck on their final examinations!

title: Research Grant Application Deadline — Internal Funding Round
author: Office of Research
excerpt: Applications for the 2025–2026 Internal Research Grant are now open. Faculty and postdoctoral researchers may apply for seed funding up to $50,000. Submission deadline is July 31, 2025.
body:
Dear Faculty and Postdoctoral Researchers,

The Office of Research invites applications for the 2025–2026 Internal Research Grant (IRG) program. The IRG provides seed funding to support innovative research projects with potential for external grant funding.

Eligibility:
• Full-time faculty (all ranks) and postdoctoral researchers
• Projects must have clear potential for follow-on external funding
• Multi-disciplinary collaborations are encouraged

Funding Available:
• Individual projects: Up to $25,000
• Collaborative projects (2+ PIs): Up to $50,000

Deadline: July 31, 2025 at 5:00 PM via the Research Portal

For application guidelines and templates, visit research.kingster.edu/irg or contact the Office of Research at research@kingster.edu.

title: Student ID Card Renewal — Class of 2025
author: Student Affairs
excerpt: Continuing students must renew their student ID cards for the 2025–2026 academic year. Renewal stations are available in the Student Union Building (Room 104) and the Library Information Desk.
body:
Dear Continuing Students,

Student ID cards for the 2024–2025 academic year will expire on August 31, 2025. All continuing students must obtain a new card for the 2025–2026 academic year.

How to Renew:
• Visit the Student Union Building, Room 104 (Mon–Fri, 9 AM – 4 PM)
• Visit the Library Information Desk (Mon–Thu, 10 AM – 6 PM)
• Bring your current student ID and a printed enrollment verification

Photo ID Replacement Fee: $15 for lost or damaged cards.

New students will receive their ID cards during orientation in August. For questions, contact studentservices@kingster.edu.
